substrate_start.meaning: Native source operand; not an experimental reliability score.

substrate_end.meaning: Native source operand; not an experimental reliability score.

total_product_start.meaning: Native source operand; not an experimental reliability score.

total_product_end.meaning: Native source operand; not an experimental reliability score.

fate_product_start.meaning: Native source operand; not an experimental reliability score.

fate_product_end.meaning: Native source operand; not an experimental reliability score.

coordinate_start.meaning: Native source operand; not an experimental reliability score.

coordinate_end.meaning: Native source operand; not an experimental reliability score.

substrate_loss.meaning: Signed observed change over the selected common window.

total_product_gain.meaning: Signed observed change over the selected common window.

fate_product_gain.meaning: Signed observed change over the selected common window.

coordinate_span.meaning: Released coordinate separation, not automatically elapsed time.

chemical_discrepancy.meaning: Signed disagreement between matched chemical readouts under declared stoichiometry.

chemical_ratio.meaning: Relative agreement of matched substrate loss and total-product gain.

chemical_relative_discrepancy.meaning: Signed relative mismatch of the same chemical readouts.

fate_fraction.meaning: Specific measured product fate relative to total measured cleavage; not enzyme attribution.

substrate_depletion_fraction.meaning: Fractional depletion, which can limit an initial-regime interpretation.

source_interval_average_substrate.meaning: Interval-average concentration change; never initial rate, Vmax or kcat.

scenario_interval_average_substrate.meaning: Interval-average concentration change; never initial rate, Vmax or kcat.

source_interval_average_total_product.meaning: Interval-average concentration change; never initial rate, Vmax or kcat.

scenario_interval_average_total_product.meaning: Interval-average concentration change; never initial rate, Vmax or kcat.

source_interval_average_fate_product.meaning: Interval-average concentration change; never initial rate, Vmax or kcat.

scenario_interval_average_fate_product.meaning: Interval-average concentration change; never initial rate, Vmax or kcat.

substrate_loss_variance.meaning: Selected-estimate uncertainty; exact linear propagation or explicitly first-order nonlinear propagation.

total_product_gain_variance.meaning: Selected-estimate uncertainty; exact linear propagation or explicitly first-order nonlinear propagation.

fate_product_gain_variance.meaning: Selected-estimate uncertainty; exact linear propagation or explicitly first-order nonlinear propagation.

coordinate_span_variance.meaning: Selected-estimate uncertainty; exact linear propagation or explicitly first-order nonlinear propagation.

chemical_discrepancy_variance.meaning: Selected-estimate uncertainty; exact linear propagation or explicitly first-order nonlinear propagation.

chemical_ratio_variance.meaning: Selected-estimate uncertainty; exact linear propagation or explicitly first-order nonlinear propagation.

fate_fraction_variance.meaning: Selected-estimate uncertainty; exact linear propagation or explicitly first-order nonlinear propagation.

source_interval_average_substrate_varian.meaning: Selected-estimate uncertainty; exact linear propagation or explicitly first-order nonlinear propagation.

source_interval_average_total_product_va.meaning: Selected-estimate uncertainty; exact linear propagation or explicitly first-order nonlinear propagation.

source_interval_average_fate_product_var.meaning: Selected-estimate uncertainty; exact linear propagation or explicitly first-order nonlinear propagation.

chemical_standardized_discrepancy.meaning: Discrepancy relative to justified joint-estimate uncertainty; no p-value or probability.
